up: Retrieve the first 1000 rows of IC50 activity data for human target CHEMBL1795194 (Phosphatidylinositol 5-phosphate 4-kinase type-2 alpha) with pChEMBL values. The results must include assay ChEMBL ID, target type, target tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, activity standard type, and pChEMBL value. Only exact IC50 rows (standard relation '=') with non-null pChEMBL values are required. No filters for assay type, organism, confidence score, or target type. Results must be ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending, then assay ChEMBL ID ascending.
sql:
WITH selected_activities AS (
  SELECT a.*
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  WHERE a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND ass.tid = 1795194
)
SELECT
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.pchembl_value
FROM selected_activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molecule_chembl_id
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;
